description: Assiettes de servitude T1 relative aux voies ferrées - version numérisée DDT 43 - Haute-Loire – 2016 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by haute-loire.gouv.fr. Public utility easements (SUPs) are administrative limitations to the right to property. They are established for the benefit of public persons, concessionaires for public services or public works, private persons engaged in an activity in the general interest. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "T1 railroad easement plates — digitised version DDT 43 — Haute-Loire — 2016" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DDT 43, open data, HAUTE-LOIRE, données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
